messages:
ana: Quick FYI 10 there's a visitor at the lobby desk with a potted orchid and a small wrapped box, no host listed. asked for a chair near the window
frontdesk-bot: Visitor check-in: name=Mr. Chen, host=unknown, ETA=2m, badge_status=pending. Package logged: PKG-9192 desc='small wrapped box', location=mail-hold
oscar: If no host shows up in 5 min, we do the usual sign-in and give a temp pass. Ana, want the window seat?
ana: (typo correction) hana: i'll take the seat for phone call, can move afterwards. also can someone check if orchid needs special care? looks damp
frontdesk-bot: Badge printer: READY. If paper feeds twice: open tray -> realign stack -> press feed button
ana: thanks. pinging #events 1 for plant rules. rory from facilities usually knows pot policies
rory: noted. real policy: plants ok in lobby but please label owner + watering schedule. i'll stick a "needs watering" card if it's requested
oscar: host message came through: host=@leah (sales). Leah says she'll be up in 3m and to hold the box in secure-hold until she arrives
ana: Leah here 1 I'm running late! thanks for holding. the box is swag for the meeting, do not open pls
oscar: box labeled and moved to secure-hold with note "Do not open - host incoming"
ana: also tiny ask: can we get a small stack of labels that say "owner:" at the mail shelf? would save us guessing next time
rory: creating ticket FACL-240 "Owner labels for mail shelf" ETA 2 business days
frontdesk-bot: Visitor badge printed: B-4472 granted lobby access. Host @leah ETA=2m
oscar: guest seated by window, umbrella stored in closet-1. all good. thanks team :thumbsup:
ana: kudos to Kris at front desk for speedy handling :clap:
end of thread
